description: Tier D. For repos nobody is developing: last push in 2023-2024, no CI, no deployment.
Routine version updates on a repo like this are pure noise — nobody is going to review a
PR bumping a linter in a repo they abandoned two years ago, and the PRs age into permanent
merge conflicts. security:only-security-updates disables every package by default and lets
only vulnerability-driven updates through, so the repo stays quiet until something is
actually exploitable. Combined with osvVulnerabilityAlerts from the base preset this still
catches direct-dependency CVEs without GitHub Advanced Security.
Nothing here is automerged: these repos have no tests at all.
